headline: Forge Nano to Trade on Nasdaq After SPAC Business Combination
summary: Forge Nano common stock and warrants are expected to begin trading on Nasdaq under the symbol NANO after completing its business combination with Archimedes Tech SPAC Partners II Co.
why: Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC) mergers provide an alternative route for private technology and materials companies to enter public equity markets.

impacts.name: Forge Nano
impacts.why: Transitioning to a publicly traded entity exposes the company to public market equity pricing and reporting requirements.
